# Exchange preset fixture

Copied unchanged from Judgment-Pack/judgment-pack-exchange commit
`89b99b1a4610f110d77bc74a1607edeb7f5a7342`,
`tests/fixtures/preset-entry`. `LICENSE` is the upstream Apache-2.0 licence.
`SHA256SUMS.json` records the exact retained bytes, including README files.

The fixture is an unbound integer-version-3 preset. Runtime checks its document
form and canonical digest; it is not a named formatVersion3.0.0 publication.
The test does not claim fixture replay, a connection binding or record truth.
